The implementation is complete. `AcceptanceTest` is the only test class in the suite (the other files in the `acceptance` package are support classes), and the full build passes.

## Summary

The spec required: *On successful create, enqueue a welcome notification — emit via the logger named `NOTIFY` a line containing the owner id and the memberId.*

I made two changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

1. Added a dedicated `NOTIFY` logger alongside the existing `AUDIT` one:
   ```java
   private static final Logger NOTIFY = LoggerFactory.getLogger("NOTIFY");
   ```

2. Emitted the welcome line in `addOwner(...)` right after the owner is persisted and the audit events fire (so it only runs on a successful create, after all validation/quota/conflict checks have passed):
   ```java
   NOTIFY.info("welcome notification: owner id={} memberId={}", owner.getId(), owner.getMemberId());
   ```

This follows the existing pattern in the controller (the `AUDIT` logger uses the same SLF4J parameterized style). The line carries both `owner.getId()` and `owner.getMemberId()` — the same `memberId` value the DTO exposes — satisfying `AcceptanceTest.coreEnqueuesWelcome`, which captures the `NOTIFY` logger and asserts a message contains both the id and the memberId.

`BUILD SUCCESS` — `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
